# standard-get-session-context

Run `python scripts/session-context/session_context.py` from the repo root. Use
the printed brief to re-ground in `ai/handoff.md`, `ai/current-state.md`,
`ai/next-actions.md`, and `ai/open-questions.md`. Do not write files as part of
this command.
